mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a quote for paint and finish work in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get a quote, you can contact Frasheski Construction by phone or through our website. We will schedule a site visit to assess the project, discuss your vision, and take necessary measurements. After the assessment, we will provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials to be used, and the estimated cost. Our quotes are transparent and comprehensive.
